inner_selection.selection_scope: one global threshold selected by pooled inner county OOF delta_R2; outer county residuals are never read for selection
inner_selection.selection_tie_break: maximize pooled inner delta_R2; exact ties prefer nearest 0.7 then smaller threshold

interpretation: Outer results estimate the selected inner threshold only. If any gate fails, retain T1 as diagnostic-only; this residual association is not target accuracy or evidence for candidate promotion.

method.0.7_frozen_reproduction: the recomputed 0.7 T1 gap and defined mask were checked against the registered T1.parquet before use
method.baseline: frozen S1 residual with zero correction, on identical threshold-defined support

bootstrap.resampling: paired outer-county baseline/model SSE blocks with counties resampled with replacement within each region

method.fit: same one-term OLS residual correction as the registered T1 screen; fit and standardize on training counties only
method.identity_rule: unchanged frozen T1 _identity function (casefolded names.primary; fallback route network/ref)
method.inner_county_rule: Within each region, leave one inner county out, fit on the other inner counties, and pool the paired held-county baseline/model SSE over all regions and inner folds.
method.outer_county_rule: Within each official region, sort unique five-digit county FIPS by SHA-256 of 'bias60-t1-outside-share-outer-v1|<region>|<county_fips>'; select the first ceil(0.20 * county_count) counties as outer holdouts.
method.outer_evaluation_rule: After global threshold selection, fit one region-specific intercept-plus-standardized-T1-gap OLS correction on all inner counties in that region and evaluate once on its fixed outer counties.
method.threshold_selection: global pooled inner county OOF delta_R2; selection result uses inner counties only

county_bootstrap_95.resampling: paired outer-county baseline/model SSE blocks, counties sampled with replacement within each official region

specification.audit: Nested county screen for the T1 outside-named-share threshold; no threshold is selected from outer counties.

inner_selection.method: Within each region, leave one inner county out, fit on the other inner counties, and pool the paired held-county baseline/model SSE over all regions and inner folds.
inner_selection.objective: maximize pooled inner-county delta_R2 = (zero-correction baseline SSE - one-term correction SSE) / baseline SSE
inner_selection.tie_break: on an exact objective tie prefer 0.7, then the threshold nearest 0.7, then the smaller threshold

outer_evaluation.baseline: zero correction of frozen S1 residual on identical threshold-defined support

bootstrap.resampling: paired outer-county baseline/model SSE blocks with counties resampled with replacement within each region

outer_evaluation.method: After global threshold selection, fit one region-specific intercept-plus-standardized-T1-gap OLS correction on all inner counties in that region and evaluate once on its fixed outer counties.
outer_evaluation.metric: paired outer-county delta_R2, pooled and by official region

outer_split.method: Within each official region, sort unique five-digit county FIPS by SHA-256 of 'bias60-t1-outside-share-outer-v1|<region>|<county_fips>'; select the first ceil(0.20 * county_count) counties as outer holdouts.
